reason: On a legal input, the starter ids are distinct, so the laws fix the tail exactly: AddsOnlyAbsent and AddsEveryAbsent make the tail ids equal the ids of the absent starters, NewInStarterOrder fixes their order and forbids duplicates, and each id names one starter, so AddsOnlyAbsent and EnabledRule fix the adapter, model and enabled flag of each row. RowsStay and NewAtEnd fix the prefix as the old registry, and Entry has no other field, so each two passing designs give the same registry.
